name: Gästehaus Franz
beschreibung: Gästehaus Franz in Tirol is a traditional inn with attached guest rooms. The location is quiet yet central in the village, from where hiking trails are directly accessible. The rooms are simply and functionally furnished and offer a balcony with a view. The dining room is frequented by guests and locals alike. The kitchen serves regional specialties and classic dishes from Tirol. The surrounding landscape is ideal for activities in every season. The house has storage facilities for bicycles and skis.
